enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Place spoon in sink. Close refrigerator. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Greet colleagues. Check schedule. Pick up patient files. Walk to treatment room. Call patient name. Assist patient to treatment table. Assess patient's condition. Demonstrate exercises. Guide patient through exercises. Adjust patient's posture. Record progress. Walk patient to waiting area. Clean equipment. Walk to next patient.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Walk outside. Sit on bench. Check phone. Walk back to department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Review patient notes. Conduct group therapy session. Set up equipment. Instruct patients on exercises. Monitor patients. Adjust equipment. Assist patient with walker. Document sessions. Clean therapy area. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Walk to reception. Schedule appointments. Return to desk.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to house. Check mailbox. Walk up steps. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Add salt. Turn off cooker. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Place plate in sink.

Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal tasks or reading
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Sit on chair. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type notes. Browse website. Watch video. Pick up book. Read pages. Put down book. Type more. Save document. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Walk out of study.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Breathe slowly. Lie still. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.
